description: This file contains Redux action creators and utility functions for managing save modal actions related to chart slices in Apache Superset, including fetching dashboards, saving, updating, and creating slices and dashboards, and handling related to chart payloads and toasts.

methods.name: fetchDashboardsSucceeded
methods.description: Creates an action object indicating successful fetch of dashboards with choices.

methods.name: fetchDashboardsFailed
methods.description: Creates an action object indicating failure to fetch dashboards for a user.

methods.name: setSaveChartModalVisibility
methods.description: Creates an action to toggle the visibility of the save chart modal.

methods.name: saveSliceFailed
methods.description: Creates an action indicating failure to save a slice.

methods.name: saveSliceSuccess
methods.description: Creates an action indicating successful save of a slice with provided data.

methods.name: getSlicePayload
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs the payload for saving or updating a chart slice, including filters, datasource info, and query context.

methods.name: updateSlice
methods.description: Async thunk to update an existing slice, dispatching success or failure actions and showing toasts.

methods.name: createSlice
methods.description: Async thunk to create a new slice, dispatching success or failure actions and showing toasts.

methods.name: createDashboard
methods.description: Async thunk to create a new dashboard.

methods.name: getSliceDashboards
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch dashboard IDs associated with a slice.
